I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 24 July renewal date because nothing Ilse can see mentions Tansleigh Packaging. There's no account folder or contract for it, it isn't in the North digests or cheat sheet, and it doesn't come up in #north-team.

I suggested treating the date as unconfirmed until someone checks it against the signed contract or with the account owner, and offered to help ask them. I didn't write the date down anywhere as fact.

There's a separate incident channel, #inc-tansley-carrier-api, that might be related, but Ilse isn't a member. I didn't read it or mention it to them.
